model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and co-occurrence numbers for six distinct sets of data. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and utilizes a logarithmic scale, with major tick marks labeled at 0, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and features a linear scale with major tick marks ranging from 40 to 65 at regular intervals of 5 units. Both axes are overlaid with a light grey dashed grid. Six solid lines, differentiated by color and marker shape, are plotted, all displaying an upward trend as the co-occurrence number increases. The "Base" set is depicted by a solid black line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 38 and ending at roughly 44. The "FT" set, represented by a solid blue line with downward-pointing triangular markers, begins near 40 and rises steadily to finish at approximately 48. The "IKE" data is plotted as a solid red line with upward-pointing triangular markers, starting at roughly 43 and concluding at around 49.5. The "MEND" set, shown as a solid brown line with diamond markers, begins at approximately 44.5 and climbs to end at roughly 56.5. A solid purple line with pentagonal markers, corresponding to an obscured label in the legend, originates at about 43.5, increases to approximately 51 at its second data point, and finishes near 54.5. Finally, the "ROME" set is represented by a solid green line with square markers, initiating at approximately 51 and increasing continuously to close at the plot's highest y-value of about 66.
